items.note: index/ + processed/ + intelligence/; no raw corpus, no versioning. S3 has no always-free storage (5 GB only in a 12-month free tier).
TableSizeBytes (refreshed about every 6 h); TTL removes demo workspaces. First 25 GB are always free.
GenerationCallsOverOne + DlqHandlerInvoked. Free tier is 10 alarms per account; the account has 12 alarms across products, so it is likely used up.

items.item: SQS requests from idle long polling (current rate)
items.note: Measured NumberOfEmptyReceives: queue 355.3/h + DLQ 540.0/h (2026-10-03 11:00-13:00 EDT). The two Lambda event source mappings poll even when nothing is queued. Free tier is 1M requests per account per month, shared with 3 other products' SQS pollers.
storedBytes of the 3 log groups (14-day retention). Idle ingestion is 0: no Lambda runs.
12 deployments x 3461120 bytes (apps/web/out), assuming every deployment is retained.

zeroCostItems.note: No provisioned or reserved concurrency (list-provisioned-concurrency-configs and get-function-concurrency empty). Code storage is not billed per GB.
Per token only; the api Lambda has no Bedrock permission and nothing is scheduled.

zeroCostItems.item: CloudWatch custom metrics (4 published so far, from 8 metric filters)
zeroCostItems.note: Metric filters publish only when a matching line arrives; custom metrics are prorated by the hour and metered only when data is sent. GenerationCallsOverOne has defaultValue 0, which also publishes only when worker lines arrive.
Charged per publish/delivery; first 1,000 email deliveries a month free.
4 Standard-tier parameters (incl. one SecureString with the AWS-managed key); standard tier and throughput are free.
SSE-S3 (AES256) and the DynamoDB default key: no KMS charge.

sharedNotAttributed.note: Shared by all of Mike's products (28 records) and existed before DiligenceIQ; not attributed. DNS queries to the Amplify records are pennies at demo traffic.
Whole shared bucket: 417 objects, 1,550,682,581 bytes across every product; DiligenceIQ's share is a few MB per deploy. The bootstrap ECR repository holds 0 images.

idleMonthly.freeTierNote: Free tiers are per account and shared with Mike's other products (CareerOps, ResolveIQ, TrustResponse). The account already has 12 alarms (free tier 10) and 3 other SQS pollers, so the no-free-tier total is the realistic one.

addendum.change: A third standard alarm, AnalysisFailedAlarm (AnalysisFailedFault Sum >= 1 in 5 min), added after a MALFORMED_OUTPUT production failure fired no alarm, with 3 more free metric filters (11 in all). Not yet deployed when added.

addendum.note: The AnalysisFailedFault custom metric publishes only in hours with a faulty failed analysis, so it adds no idle cost.

bedrockGeneration.finding: Billed Sonnet 4.6 rates through the us. inference profile are $3.3/M input and $16.5/M output, 10% above the code table ($3/$15), so estimatedCostUsd understates billed generation cost by about 10%.

queryEmbedding.note: one short query, ~50 tokens (assumed) at Titan v2 price

servingUpperBound.note: All DynamoDB, API Gateway and api-Lambda usage over 2026-10-01..03 (every page view, workspace seed and poll, not just analyses), divided by the worker invocations: an upper bound per analysis.

corpusEmbedding.note: Billed figure covers the interrupted c1 run, its resume and the c2 re-embed (docs/handoffs/phase-02.md: 22.1M tokens, about $0.44).

profileBuildAllPromptVersions.note: v1 trial 3 + v2 trial 3 + v3 trial 3 + v3 on 50; the det-v2 set made 0 calls.

sonnetBilledOct1to3.note: All Sonnet 4.6 use in the account 2026-10-01..03 (profile builds, generation evals, production analyses); 10-03 incomplete in billing.

worstCaseDay.ceilingAssumptions: each analysis 30,000 input tokens (observed max 29,885; context budget ~24K) and the full 8,192-token output cap at billed rates, worker running to its 180 s timeout. One generation call per analysis (conditional claim), so redeliveries add no Bedrock cost.

apiFloodDayUsd.note: HTTP API stage throttle 10 req/s sustained all day; API Gateway + api Lambda (mean 150 ms at 256 MB) only; DynamoDB reads per request and log ingestion not included

worstCaseDay.notCapped: Amplify data transfer out ($0.15/GB served) is not bounded by any cap.
